peers.name: CoreWeave
peers.sourceTitle: Multiples.vc CoreWeave comps, Morningstar and FactSet
peers.definition: LTM revenue and EBITDA are rounded to $12 billion and $7.3 billion on that page. The 12.2x figure uses that EBITDA, which is above the GAAP TTM EBITDA in the GuruFocus row.

peers.name: CoreWeave, GAAP EBITDA
peers.definition: Enterprise value $89,792 million divided by GAAP EBITDA of $5,347 million for the twelve months ended September 2026. Share price on that page was $53.13.

peers.name: Oracle
peers.sourceTitle: GuruFocus EV/EBITDA for ORCL, revenue from GNG Research
peers.definition: EV/EBITDA is GuruFocus on November 24, 2026: enterprise value $470,963 million over EBITDA of $37,947 million for the twelve months ended August 2026. EV/revenue is that same enterprise value divided by TTM revenue of $71.78 billion through August 31, 2026, as compiled by GNG Research on November 23, 2026. The two publishers do not use one enterprise-value figure.
